description: Check housing affordability in a market. Returns mortgage rate, median price, monthly payment, required income, and HUD limits. Optionally specify metro (e.g., "Denver"). The inputs are official statistics on DIFFERENT cadences — a weekly mortgage rate against a quarterly median price — so the monthly payment is an illustrative ratio of published figures, not a live quote. `freshness` states the span and the age of each input.

_blsKey.description: BLS registration key (optional — raises the shared quota; https://data.bls.gov/registrationEngine/)

_hudKey.description: HUD API token (optional — needed for income limits)

metro_name.description: Metro name for metro-level FHFA HPI (e.g., "Denver", "Savannah"). Optional.

state.description: State name or two-letter code (e.g., "California" or "CA"). Resolved for you — pass this rather than state_code. Optional: without it you still get the national mortgage rate, median price and affordability math, just no HUD income limits.

state_code.description: Two-letter state code for HUD income limits (e.g., "CO"). `state` is preferred and accepts either form.

name: housing_affordability_check
